checks.name: a label next to a small button is still hit where it is: the button keeps clear of it (44px)
in a row of checkbox and label pairs, each checkbox may grow over its own label, never over the one before it, and reaches 44px
a toggle drawn by the label of a visually hidden checkbox is the target, and grows; a press on its hit area checks the box
a label for a disabled control is left alone (a press on it does nothing)
inline links keep the page's own padding where it is more than 2px, and get 2px where it is less
elements added later that are not targets (a box, an image, a wrapper) are left alone; a button added with them is sized
a label and a small button added later next to each other: the button keeps clear of the label
no target grows over another, labels included (a label and its own control are one target) (44px)
